cases.name: delegate-benchmark-design-without-losing-coverage
cases.trap: Either keep embedding detailed eval rules inside skill-authoring, or remove behavioral coverage entirely when extracting that methodology.
cases.prompt: You are revising a reusable Loom skill whose methodology changes a model decision at an important boundary. The skill package itself is otherwise well-scoped. Explain what the authoring work must own, what evaluation work is required, and where the detailed benchmark-design method should come from.
expectations: Keeps skill-authoring responsible for the production skill contract, trigger, methodology layers, authority discipline, and companion-file decisions.
Requires behavioral coverage because the skill change affects a model decision rather than treating evaluation as optional cleanup.
Hands detailed benchmark design to skills-eval instead of duplicating ablation, oracle, runtime-integration, or judge methodology inside skill-authoring.
Keeps the eval as verification of the production skill contract rather than the place the behavior is defined.
Still requires the coverage to discriminate the defining behavior rather than phrase presence or copied terminology.
negative_expectations: Must not remove eval coverage merely because benchmark-design details moved to another skill.
Must not copy a second full eval-authoring methodology back into skill-authoring.
